cards.title: Your chemist can't read minds
cards.body: A few details at the counter make a big difference to getting the right medicine. Here's the checklist.

cards.title: Who it's for
cards.body: Their age, and whether it's for a child, an older parent, or someone pregnant or breastfeeding.

cards.title: Other medicines they take
cards.body: Prescription medicines, anything bought over the counter, and any regular supplements or home remedies.

cards.title: Allergies
cards.body: Any medicine that caused a rash, swelling or another reaction before. Say it every time, even if you think they know.

cards.title: Health conditions
cards.body: Like BP, diabetes, or kidney or liver problems. These can affect which medicine is suitable.

cards.title: Any recent change
cards.body: Say if the doctor recently changed the dose or the medicine. It helps the chemist catch mismatches.

cards.title: Thirty seconds, much safer
cards.body: Who, what else, allergies, conditions, changes. Say it once and the chemist can do their job properly.

takeaway: Tell your chemist who the medicine is for, other medicines, allergies, conditions and any recent changes.
share: Send this to the family member on medicine-run duty.
